title: Cycle count on the Inactive tab counts only the inactive parts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active tracked part, part A, with 5 in its bin.
  • Have two inactive tracked parts, part B and part C, with 5 each.
  • Give parts A, B and C part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists all three.
  • Make sure no Cycle count is running on the Inventory list.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Inactive tab.
  2. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  3. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  4. Click Cycle count.
  5. Click the printer icon in the count toolbar.
  6. Close the print preview without printing.
  7. Click Cancel in the count toolbar.
  8. Click the Active tab.
  9. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box again.
  10. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮).
  11. Click Cycle count.
  12. Click Cancel in the count toolbar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 2:

  • Parts B and C are listed.

Step 3:

  • The menu on the Inactive tab offers Cycle count.

Step 4:

  • The count starts on the Inactive tab: parts B and C are listed, each with an empty Count box.
  • Part A is not listed.

Step 5:

  • The count sheet lists parts B and C.
  • Part A is not on it.

Step 6:

  • The print preview closes and the count is still running.

Step 7:

  • The count ends without saving: parts B and C still show 5 Available.

Step 8:

  • The Active tab is selected.

Step 9:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 10:

  • The menu opens.

Step 11:

  • The count lists part A with a Count box.
  • Parts B and C are not listed.

Step 12:

  • The count ends without saving.
